prompt: Finding the nearest match in a stored vector collection:

options.label: sqlite-vec (exact linear scan), 5,000 vectors
options.content: Compares the query against every one of the 5,000 stored vectors and returns the mathematically exact closest match, guaranteed. At this scale the comparison is essentially instant - there's no real cost to checking everything, so there's no reason to trade away the guarantee of exactness.

options.label: Dedicated vector DB with HNSW indexing, 50,000,000 vectors
options.content: Checking all 50 million vectors on every query would be far too slow. HNSW's pre-built graph structure lets the search jump toward the likely neighborhood of good matches and skip the overwhelming majority of vectors entirely - dramatically faster, at the cost of no longer guaranteeing the single mathematically exact closest match, just a very good one almost all the time.
